description: Frozen golden manifest for the sealed Phase-7 fallback plan-preset registry (guanlan_v2.orchestration.plan_presets.load_preset_registry over config/orchestration/presets/*.json). registry_digest is the order-independent content_digest over the sorted PlanPresetManifestEntry list; each entry pins a reviewed preset (preset_id, version) to the sha256+cjson-v1 semantic content digest of its PlanPresetRecord. The one reviewed v1 preset main.research_baseline is the Phase-2 pilot triad text.sentiment -> dec.research_mgr -> dec.pm (final workers only, every dependency BLOCK, sink dec.pm, static-profile-admissible: no gates/debate/condition_ref, max_attempts==1). NEVER auto-regenerated by tests: a changed manifest is a reviewed contract change regenerated by hand and re-reviewed. Editing any preset file breaks this golden. See tests/orchestration/test_plan_presets.py.
